status: MOTION TEST ONLY - provisional timing, no voice; not an approved pilot render
units: seconds = pilot timeline; screen px on a 1920x1080 frame; source px for camera; angles in degrees, PIL convention (positive = counter-clockwise)
easing_vocabulary: tools/motion/easing.py (see docs/MOTION_GUIDE.md); the easing on keyframe i shapes the segment to keyframe i+1

camera.rule: window width never below 1920 source px: the NASA frame is downscaled, never upscaled
camera.note: camera keys span the whole pilot beat B04 (12-18 s); the 5 s test window only shows part of the push, so it never decelerates to a stop at the test cut

background_depth.why: the satellite frame recedes (soft focus + local dim) while the illustration is the subject; it returns to full clarity only after the scene

tree_intact.pivot_note: right (lee-side) edge of the root plate: a tree uprooted by wind from the left tips about this edge, so the left roots lift
tree_intact.angle_note: anticipation 2 deg back into the wind, then tipping integrated from the inverted-pendulum equation (preset 'topple'); impact when the crown reaches the ground

handoff.why: the intact painting cannot become the broken one by moving; the swap is a 3-frame dissolve inside the impact, masked by motion blur, the dust burst in front and the shake

tree_uprooted.match_note: placement chosen by silhouette overlap with the intact tree at -54 deg (IoU 0.50, trunk and root plate aligned); nothing is pushed below the ground line

labels.credit: Background: NASA EO-1 ALI, May 2, 2011 · NASA Earth Observatory / Jesse Allen & Robert Simmon
